scope: repositories-only button behavior completion and Cursor Agent parity follow-up
cursorAgentObservations: Computer Use observed Cursor Agent Repositories with multiple projects visible before switching, including sciforge, Home, and openteam-studio.
Cursor repository histories can exceed the first visible page; See more keeps paging additional rows instead of being capped at eight model rows.
Cursor row actions remain state-specific: completed/history rows expose Pin and Archive, draft rows expose Pin and Discard.
Cursor project header context menus expose Mark All as Read, Archive All, and Remove from Sidebar.
sciforgeIssuesFound: SciForge project groups were still built from an eight-row model limit, so the UI See more control could not reveal repository history beyond the pre-truncated rows.
Mark All as Read existed in the Cursor-like menus but only emitted a notice; there was no sidebar read-state mutation to make the button real.

Activating a non-current repository switched the workspace path but left workspaceWriterBaseUrl on the departing/current project writer, while the departing project retained the target peer writer in peerInstances.
The Agent Host sidebar semantic projection exposed row-level archive/discard actions but did not publish a project-level Archive All command intent.
sciforgeChanges: Removed the default pre-truncation inside buildSidebarProjectThreadGroups; repository groups now retain the full sorted thread history, leaving default display and paging to SidebarProjectChatSection.
Added readThreadIds to sidebar preferences plus markThreadIdsRead; global and project Mark All as Read now persist visible thread ids as read, and opening a thread marks that thread read.
Added unread row/dot styling using existing SciForge sidebar tokens so the read-state is visible in both dark and light modes.
Fixed workspace project activation to carry the target peer workspaceWriterUrl into workspaceWriterBaseUrl and preserve the departing current workspace as a peer with the previous writer.
Published project-level archive-project / Archive All in the Cursor Agent semantic projection with terminal-equivalent commandText.
sciforgeLiveVerification: Connected to the current in-app Browser tab at http://localhost:5173/ and inspected the Repositories DOM without mutating user state.
The current live workspace only had one p2 draft row, so Archive All, Archive, and Remove from Sidebar were not clicked in the user's real state.
The live draft row exposed New Agent and Discard draft controls; completed-row destructive behavior remains covered by isolated/focused state tests from earlier rounds and the current test suite.
openNotes: Automations, top Customize, and sidebar search remain outside this round per the narrowed Repositories focus.
The user's current live workspace lacked completed rows, so this round avoided destructive Browser clicks against the real session and relied on isolated state tests for Archive/Delete/Restore.
Full visual parity remains an active live task; this round specifically closes behavior gaps for Repositories buttons, project writer routing, read-state, and See more model capacity.
